sales-call-prep.description: Prepare a sourced brief for one sales call or a named calendar window.

interaction-sync.description: Turn one completed customer interaction into reviewed CRM updates and an unsent follow-up draft.

task-triage-speed-run.description: Review due CRM tasks, prepare contextual follow-ups, and apply approved changes.

pipeline-review.description: Review opportunity hygiene and propose evidence-supported next-step and field updates.

forecast-weekly.description: Build an evidence-backed quarterly forecast and propose explicit CRM corrections.

pilot-usage.description: Summarize one pilot's adoption from a configured analytics source.

close.description: Review a signed opportunity's close and track approved downstream handoff effects.
